summary: Iteration 13 tested 5 features: subscription lifecycle, project team, fleet, per-project access control and selfie attendance. Backend: the new pytest suite passes 12/12 (tests/test_iter13_subscription_fleet_access.py). The regression run of iter12+iter10 passes 41/43. The 2 failures are old vehicle tests that the new fleet spec made obsolete, so they are now marked skip. Frontend: the trial-ended screen, trial banner, Super Admin billing settings + Trial & renewal dialog, Add people dialog, PermDialog (16 modules), Activities tab hidden for an engineer set to None, nav-my-attendance + checkin-prompt, the PM team attendance view (selfie preview + map link), the full Vehicles tab flow (engineer request -> PM approve -> Add to fleet -> assign -> driver start/return on /trips), the /fleet page for admin and PM, the dashboard fleet-status-card, the Accounts 'Billing' nav and the mobile project dropdown all work. Found 1 functional gap (residential geofence) and a few minor issues. The preview env had a few transient 'src/index.js failed to load' and Cloudflare challenge pages; these were not app bugs.

critical.issue: The geofence endpoint uses C.commercial_user, so a residential PM gets 403 and has no UI to set a site geofence. If a residential member has 'Site location required' turned on, they can never check in at that project (400 'PM has not set the site geofence yet'). They can only pick Office / off-site. Fix: allow residential PMs to set the geofence (and add UI for it), or hide the location toggle in residential.

minor.issue: 3 legacy requests still have status 'completed'. They were not migrated to 'returned' and still show a 'completed' badge on the Vehicles tab, /fleet and /trips (e.g. 15 Mar 2027 Bandra site, 12 Feb 2027, 04 Jan 2027).

The URL->module mapping uses substring matching. 'files/' maps to photos, so a member whose Photos access is None also gets 403 when downloading document/drawing files through /api/files/{id}/download. Consider mapping file downloads by the file's own module.

ui_bugs.issue: Team tab builds its list from the team array, engineer_ids, PM and client, and ignores project_members. pass@civio.build is a member of proj-demo-1 (in project_members) but does not appear in the Team list (4 of 4 people), and the Add people dialog offers him as addable.
Unknown routes such as /dashboard render a blank page. There is no catch-all/404 route in App.js.

GET /superadmin/settings/billing fires twice. If the admin types before the response arrives, the form state is overwritten and Save sends empty values. In the first test run, Save persisted {payment_instructions:'', default_trial_days:null}. Seed the form only once.

design_issues.screen: LifecycleDialog / Fleet vehicle dialog / Vehicles request / Team attendance date
issues: These use the browser's native <input type='date'> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker
The Attendance module shows level 'Custom' by default because the preset is ['create'] without 'view'. This is confusing for PMs.
Price suffix is inconsistent between plans: '/monthly' vs '/month' (billing_period value is printed raw)
Both a 'Team' tab and a 'Members' tab are shown, which overlap in purpose

action_items: Enable geofence setting (API + UI) for residential PMs, or hide 'Site location required' in residential workspaces
TeamTab: include project_members-only users (e.g. pass coordinator) in the team list and exclude them from the Add people candidates
Add a catch-all route (redirect to / or a 404 page)
Billing settings card: don't overwrite the form after the user starts typing (double GET)
Optional: map /files/{id}/download to the file's module instead of photos; replace native date inputs with the shadcn Calendar
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2138 lines and commercial.py is 866 lines, both over the 700-line guideline
route_module relies on substring order in ROUTE_MODULES and is fragile for future routes (e.g. a 'restore' path would match 'store'). Prefer explicit per-route module declarations.

Subscription reminder emails go only to role=admin users of the enterprise (owner included because the owner is admin). OK, but there is no retry if Resend fails, because the dedupe row is inserted before sending.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all flows work; residential geofence gap + Team list inconsistency)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test vehicles, vehicle requests, staff_attendance rows, the eng2 project_member row, platform_settings billing and TEST_ Trial Co enterprises were cleaned up. civio-homes subscription fields were unset. One subscription_email_log row for civio-homes (today) was left from the cron dedupe test. reset_superadmin.py was run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. With xdist, the subscription-expiry tests on civio-homes race with the other tests. The server clock reads 2026-10-20. proj-demo-1 originally has no geofence and no project_members row for user-eng2; restore both after tests. The architect on proj-res-1 had attendance_required=true set by the main agent (kept). Residential geofence is not settable.
rca of the issue: Residential geofence: store.py set_geofence depends on C.commercial_user (require_module 'dpr'), which residential workspaces lack. staff_attendance.check_in nevertheless enforces the geofence for residential members with location_required. Team list gap: TeamTab.jsx computes people/onProject from project.team, engineer_ids, PM and client only. Users added through Members (project_members) are omitted.
